comments.author: High-_-Cat
comments.body_html: I’ve always wanted every caliber to be viable in some way, so this mod is awesome. Do you think you could add a round that pens t4, but is still weaker then AP?

comments.author: Carbon Black
comments.body_html:
I appreciate the compliment.

As for the round, I don’t really know how to accomplish that effectively. Each of the 4 .366 rounds already cover tier 1 - 4 levels of pen + I don’t know how to model a new bullet to fit in. If I made a FMJ clone and made it pen tier 4 but have like 70 damage, Enh I feel like it wouldn’t exactly be worth using or making since EKO is right there, and AP-M is pretty easily craftable (especially using my Ammo Crafting Mod). If this was something like 762 Tokarev or another ammo with a clear vanilla limitation, I’d be more inclined to.

comments.author: High-_-Cat
comments.body_html: Ahh. You’re actually so right lol… But since you mention it, would you consider making expansions to 762, 9x18, etc?

comments.author: Carbon Black
comments.body_html: I would and have experimented with that exact idea in 9x18, .45, and 762TT already! I need to test a bit more and figure out what I want to implement exactly. I feel like I will release a mod adding clones (Again I do not know how to model or retexture yet sadly) of ammos to add niches or just make them more viable eventually, just do not know when.

comments.author: High-_-Cat
comments.body_html:
That’s awesome, I hope it all goes well for you.

Also just thought I’d add that the way I play SPT in terms of loot rate, and with teammates, we avoid sharing calibers because then we’d have to fight for ammo, which means you just have to use what you can find. Which is why I like this mod because as I said it adds the ability to stick with .366 and not handicap yourself. With that said it’d be cool if you consider 20g as well.
